description: Runtime routing floors, reasoning policy, and analysis-wave cap. Router and policy load this file; missing keys fall back to adaptive_grok.router / policy defaults.
principles: use low reasoning by default and reserve high reasoning for architecture, task framing, security, and release decisions
add Bitrix specialist whenever repository or task has Bitrix signals
add security review for auth, PII, AI, production, and external writes
bind evidence to the current repository fingerprint
do not pad the analysis wave with unmatched domain specialists

reasoning.enforcement: Agent effort is declared in .grok/agents/*.md. Model-facing subagent spawn does not provide a per-call reasoning override.
